== Title ==
<span lang="ja">レッド2</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットを1名と、操縦ドロイドを1体追加できる。ウェッジが操縦しているなら耐：損耗＜3。パイロットなしでは戦闘力、回避力、航行速度を使用できない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いでウェッジが搭乗したＸウイング。デス・スターのトレンチにおける戦闘では、被弾して飛行用の精密機器を破壊されたため、ウェッジはやむなく帰還せざるを得なかった。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Red 2]].

'''Lore''' — Wedge's X-wing at the Battle of Yavin. In the Death Star trench battle it was hit and its precision flight instruments were destroyed, so Wedge had no choice but to return.

'''Game text''' — May add 1 pilot and 1 piloting droid. If Wedge is piloting, immune to attrition less than 3. Without a pilot, power, maneuver, and hyperspeed cannot be used.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese lore names destroyed precision flight instruments and a forced return. English names micro-maneuvering controls and nursing the fighter home. 操縦ドロイド is astromech. Game effects otherwise match.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-red2-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Red 2]].</ref>
